app.name: Grooming Flow
app.tagline: Your wardrobe, one outfit a day.

today.title: Today
today.wornHint: Changed your mind? Undo and pick again.
today.noAlternatives: Nothing else fits this slot today.
today.estimated: No forecast for this day: dressed for a typical {{band}} day
today.noLocation: Set your location so the outfit follows the weather.
today.noItems: Add a few items and the first outfit appears here.
today.nothingEligible: Nothing in the wardrobe fits today's weather and occasion.
today.noCombination: No combination passes the style rules today. Try another occasion or add items.

reason.rotation: the {{item}} has not been worn in {{days}} days
reason.noWaterproofOuter: no water-resistant coat in the wardrobe, so any coat
reason.noWaterproofShoes: no waterproof boots in the wardrobe
reason.formalityRelaxed: a touch off the occasion's formality

empty.title: Your wardrobe is empty
empty.body: Photograph one item at a time, up to 50 at once. The app sorts them; you confirm.

add.title: Add items
add.hint: One photo per item, up to 50 at once. Shoot on a plain background in daylight.
add.modelsHint: One-time download of about {{mb}} MB, kept on your phone. Photos never leave the device.
add.duplicate: Looks like {{name}} you already have. Same item?
add.unsupported: This file could not be read ({{type}}). Try a JPEG or PNG.
add.limit: Up to 50 photos at a time

item.title: Item
item.deleteConfirm: Delete this item and its photo? Its history stays.

history.title: History
history.empty: Logged outfits appear here, one per day.
history.logHint: Pick what you wore; the app proposes from that day's weather.

settings.title: Settings
settings.runsHotHint: Shifts the weather bands by up to 3 °C.
settings.cooldownsHint: Days before an item can return after being worn.
settings.storageWarning: Storage is getting full. Make a backup and retire items you no longer wear.
settings.persistedNo: Not granted: add the app to your home screen and make backups.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restore merges the backup into this wardrobe. Continue?
settings.backupNudgeDays: the last one is over 30 days old
settings.backupNudgeItems: 25 new items since the last one
settings.deleteAllHint: Type DELETE to erase the wardrobe, history and settings on this device.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Everything stays on this device: photos, wardrobe, history. No account, no analytics, no cookies. The only connections are the forecast (Open-Meteo) and the one-time download of the models (Hugging Face) and their runtime (jsDelivr).

settings.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Style rules distilled from Polina's Grooming seminar (Real Men Real Style, Gentleman's Gazette).
settings.modelsBody: Classifier {{classifier}}, background removal {{bg}}. Downloaded once; delete to free space.

diag.installHint: On iPhone: Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android: menu, then Install app.

install.title: First, install the app
install.body: On iPhone, storage is only safe for an app on the home screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open it from there. On Android: menu, then Install app.

step1.title: Where are you?
step1.body: The forecast for your location decides the outfit. Nothing is tracked; the choice stays on this phone.

step2.title: Your week
step2.body: A default occasion per weekday. You can change any day on the Today screen.

step3.title: Add your first items
step3.body: Ten items are enough for a first outfit. Photograph one item at a time.
